A '''liana''' was a woody vine that grew on trees in the [[Kinkosa rain forest|rain forest]] on [[Kirtania]]. They were visually similar to [[jungle slinker]]s, and the two were often mistaken for each other.

The vine grew among the exotic (and mostly predatory) flora and fauna of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt's]] [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] in her [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|palace]], near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>
